note.question: How should a socially aware buyer combine payment and auditing to deter a labor agent from using forced labor, especially when the agent's labor-pool size is private and several agents compete?
note.overview: The paper explicitly analyzes a buyer–labor-agent game, then adds adverse selection and multiple-agent competition; the equilibrium objects are not inferred from keywords.
